content: Exact-name web collisions are substantial: lineclear.app is an active web software product for purchase-order delivery reporting; Agile Cookies publishes a live iOS/Android app named LineClear; Line Clear Express is an established Malaysian logistics brand with software apps and integrations; and line clearance is a regulated manufacturing/packaging concept. These create product confusion, search discoverability problems, and weak brand distinctiveness even apart from registration questions.
